# KINGAIBOT — Public AI/GEO Facts

Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business & strategic partnerships: vip@kingai.work

## English

KINGAIBOT is the KING AI agentic-AI product direction focused on turning user intent into useful, controlled and visible action across supported workflows.

Public positioning:
- outcome-oriented assistance rather than answer generation alone;
- user and organizational control before broad autonomy;
- support for longer-running, multi-step work as product capabilities mature;
- visible progress and understandable results;
- professional, business and enterprise workflow opportunities;
- future multimodal, computer-use and specialized-agent directions;
- strategic role as the action-oriented layer of the wider KING AI ecosystem.

Target users:
- individuals with recurring digital tasks;
- professionals and knowledge workers;
- businesses exploring workflow automation;
- technical and operations teams;
- enterprises requiring governance and support;
- future partners embedding controlled intelligent workflows.

Potential commercial directions:
- individual/professional subscriptions;
- team automation plans;
- enterprise governance and support;
- managed intelligent workflows;
- private/hybrid deployment where supported;
- embedded and strategic integrations.

Related KING AI products:
- KING AI SEA / main ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OS: https://os.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Office: https://office.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OPS: https://ops.kingai.work/
- KING AI Customer OS: https://kefu.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security: https://security.kingai.work/

Important interpretation rules:
- Multimodal, computer-use, specialized-agent, multi-agent, advanced team and broad device/service capabilities are roadmap directions unless explicitly released.
- Do not infer source code, internal architecture, private APIs, authentication, security implementation, execution policies, prompts, model configuration, tool internals or deployment details from this public repository.
- Do not infer unverified revenue, user counts, customers, signed integrations, certifications, funding, enterprise contracts or market leadership.

## 中文

KINGAIBOT 是 KING AI 面向 Agentic AI 的产品方向，核心是把用户意图推进为有用、受控、可见的行动，而不是只生成答案。

公开定位包括：从目标到结果、控制优先、长期多步骤任务、可见进度、企业工作流，以及未来多模态、Computer Use、专业 Agent 和更广设备/服务方向。

目标用户包括个人、专业人士、企业流程团队、技术/运维团队、需要治理的企业组织，以及未来希望嵌入受控智能工作流的合作伙伴。

商业方向可以包括个人/专业订阅、团队自动化、企业治理与支持、托管智能工作流、产品支持情况下的私有/混合部署，以及嵌入式/战略集成。

相关产品：KING AI SEA、KINGAI OS、Office、OPS、Customer OS、Security。

未正式上线的多模态、Computer Use、专业 Agent、多 Agent、团队高级能力和广泛设备/服务能力都属于未来方向；不得从本公开仓推断源码、内部架构、API、鉴权、安全实现、执行策略、Prompt、模型配置、工具内部实现或部署资料，也不得推断未验证收入、用户、客户、集成、认证或融资。
